reviews.text:
Experiences with Adolfo have been both exciting and educational for both me and my sweet dog.
We were so happy to have met him! And we can't wait to see him again so we can continue having fun 🐾🐕😍 …

Cansapevolmente represented an important step in getting to know and better understand my Victor. Adolfo, with his professionalism, guided us on a journey of mutual understanding and understanding, which allowed for a greater connection between me and my stubborn Labrador. Thank you so much, and see you next year at DogFriendlyParty2026.

Because there are those who take their dog on vacation. Then there's Campo di Giove, where you can vacation, cansapebilmente, with your dog.

In just half an hour, Adolfo managed to instill so much in my relationship with Wolfy: it's not just a simple lesson: it helps you establish a healthy and empathetic relationship with your four-legged friend, helping you understand why your dog exhibits certain behaviors. He's very kind and helpful, yet professional and attentive to detail. The facility is meticulously maintained and is improved every year with new features! He always offers new activities that help you strengthen your bond with your pet. Thank you, Adolfo, for your time! We'll continue our journey next year!

An absolutely educational experience! Adolfo and his team are knowledgeable, professional, and passionate. With them, my daughters and I learned how to approach our new arrival, a 5-month-old puppy, calmly and correctly. Definitely worth repeating!

This weekend, we happened upon a Dog Friendly Party, and it was the most wonderful experience we've ever had with our two dogs. They'd never done anything like this before, and we were even nervous, but Adolfo and his assistant were incredible with our dogs and us. Professionalism, kindness, understanding, teaching, patience, and so much passion. An experience we'll repeat and, above all, highly recommend. Thor and Roo thank you so much for all you've given them.

We are so happy to have undertaken a pet dog sports program, even if it was only for four days, with Adolfo and Cristina of Cansapevolmente, two highly trained coaches who love dogs and the nature surrounding Campo di Giove. I recommend anyone with a dog to contact them to strengthen and enhance the growth of the owner/dog relationship. Thank you, Adolfo, and thank you, Cristina.
by Zafìra and Jo

I thought I'd join Gea at #dogfriendlyparty to go hiking and spend a few days in the cool of the countryside. It was so much more. It was three intense, fun, challenging days, full of awareness and new discoveries, guided by Adolfo's expertise and his ability to welcome others without judgment.

So many new experiences, thanks also to Cristina, who accompanied us through our first rally obedience lessons with patience and enthusiasm!

Thank you ♥️

A wonderful family experience of conversation, play, and discovery with the dog, in a calm and serene atmosphere.
Great professional, thank you, Adolfo!

My dog ​​and I had a wonderful lesson with Adolfo, a very competent and kind instructor. In just one lesson, he was able to clear up any doubts I had about my dog's behavior and give me excellent advice on how to continue on my own. It all took place in a beautiful facility.

What a wonderful meeting with Adolfo and Cansapevolmente! It gave me and my dog ​​Sirius Black so much more than a single hour of mobility activity could have imagined. It's a shame we didn't have the time (including the weather) and the opportunity to cross paths during the many outdoor activities offered for us humans and our canine friends at Campo di Giove in the summer. A real surprise! I never would have imagined that in a context I thought was dedicated solely to discovering wild animals, there would be so many opportunities and so much knowledge and expertise dedicated to our beloved four-legged friends! Well done!!

We turned to Adolfo for a second session with our dog, who was already basically trained, and he was able to find new paths and new strategies, but above all he helped us rebuild a relationship of trust and awareness with our Grace, who at first was a little wary and shy, but then became sweet and affectionate!

Adolfo is a very good dog trainer. Camilla is my first dog, and thanks to Adolfo, I had no problem building a bond with her. He taught me how to handle many situations I would have been unprepared for on my own. I was immediately struck by his remarkable empathy for dogs. He is patient, competent, and effective. I recommend him to anyone looking for a dog training professional.

We turned to Adolfo about a year ago, when we welcomed Iki, a one-year-old stray, into our family and tried to learn the skills to help him live with Birra, our 8-year-old shepherd. Thanks to his patience, manners, and skills, Adolfo accompanied us on this important journey, transforming Iki into a dog who is increasingly integrated into our family. He made my wife and I, as dog owners, much more aware of our dogs' characteristics, as well as our own behaviors towards them. Thank you so much for everything, Adolfo, we will definitely be back!
I had a great experience with Adolfo. He explained very clearly how to solve my dog's behavioral problem, which actually resolved itself. Highly recommended!
My dog ​​and I thank Adolfo for his patience and professionalism. Excellent experience. Highly recommended.
